title: Return retained alias-send outcomes without requiring unrelated peer availability
outcome: An identical alias-addressed retained send can recover its original outcome during an unrelated peer outage without reinterpreting the target or weakening ambiguity checks.
acceptance: Committed and unknown-outcome alias retries preserve the exact retained identity/digest/key and make no second append when an unrelated peer becomes unavailable.
Either the original receipt is returned under a safe retained-target check or the refusal explicitly names the authoritative retry route; new ambiguous aliases remain fail-closed.
